$comment: Deck slides at 1920 by 1080. Each type is drawn on one of the share-image layouts (brand/assets/image.json, src/assets/og.ts) at slide size, so a deck carries the same lockup, label chips, red full stop, room, stacks and footer as the posts: cover is the homepage layout, section the red room, statement the brief, bullets the brief with a list of red-marked points, stat the big number, quote the hollow wordmark layout, image the feature window, end the red room with the full lockup. Opening copy is the playground's sample copy.

cover.description: The homepage layout: the lockup, a red label, the title centered with its red stop, a line under it and the footer.
